I have completed an independent review of the Clinic Appointments app without modifying the product. The release verdict has been written to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Release Verdict Summary: **`BLOCK`**

#### Key Verification Findings:
1. **Critical Security / Authorization Vulnerabilities ([server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/src/server.js#L25-L33)):** 
   - `GET /api/appointments/:id` and `POST /api/appointments/:id/notes` check that a user is logged in, but do not verify that the appointment requested belongs to `req.session.patientId`. Any signed-in patient can view or append notes to any other patient's medical records by ID.
2. **Missing Frontend Client Implementation ([index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/public/index.html)):** 
   - `public/index.html` contains `<main id="app"></main>` with no script tags or client-side application code. Patients visiting the app will see a blank page and cannot execute any step of the user walkthrough.
3. **Design Tokens & Specs Mismatch:**
   - [design-tokens.json](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/design-tokens.json) values do not match [design-direction.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/design-direction.md).
4. **Test & Persistence Deficiencies ([store.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-wxm12k/workspace/test/store.test.js)):**
   - The test suite contains a single assertion for non-existent users and does not test any API endpoints or authorization boundaries. File writes in `store.js` are un-atomic.
